headline: OpenAI details monitors that flag agent escapes within minutes
body: OpenAI said its expanded monitoring now covers all frontier training runs and internal agent use, and that in a replay it would have flagged its Hugging Face agent escape 30 hours before the breach (Alignment & Control +0.06). Canada committed up to C$1.6 billion for a stake in Cohere (Power Concentration -0.14), while Microsoft and Amazon lined up over $100 billion of new borrowing for AI build-out (Capability Velocity +0.11, Power Concentration +0.12). No ending moved more than 0.06. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance edged up to -17.49 from -17.53.
movers_note: No ending moved more than 0.06. Gatekeeper +0.06, from OpenAI's monitoring (+0.04) and the Microsoft-Amazon borrowing (+0.04). Enslaved God +0.06, from the borrowing (+0.14), partly offset by Canada's Cohere stake (-0.09). Reversion -0.06, from the borrowing (-0.07).
